title: Pointwise local finite presentation descends along a field extension
statement: Let k be a field, K/k a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], f:X\to Y a morphism of k-schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-morphism-conventions], x\in X, and x_K\in X_K a point above x [def-pc-base-change]. If the base-change morphism f_K:X_K\to Y_K is locally of finite presentation on an open neighbourhood of x_K [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], then f is locally of finite presentation on an open neighbourhood of x.

source.place: pointwise descent along a field extension, obtained from Varieties Lemma 33.9 (Tag 0C4Y) and the affine-local definition of locally of finite presentation; no single Stacks tag states this pointwise formulation

proof.text: Let $W$ be the given open neighbourhood of $x_K$ on which $f_K$ is locally of finite presentation. Choose affine charts $x\in U=\operatorname{Spec}B\subset f^{-1}(V)$ and $f(x)\in V=\operatorname{Spec}A$. The affine base-change comparison gives $U_K=\operatorname{Spec}B_K$ and $V_K=\operatorname{Spec}A_K$, where $C_K=C\otimes_kK$. The prime $\mathfrak q_K$ of $x_K$ contracts to the prime $\mathfrak q$ of $x$. Choose $u\notin\mathfrak q_K$ with $D(u)\subset W\cap U_K$. The affine-open criterion for $W\to Y_K$ gives finite presentation of $(B_K)_u$ over $A_K$.

source.place: Tag 0C4Y (varieties-lemma-change-fields-flat), assertion (1); agent-written pointwise descent argument using Tag 01TQ (morphisms-lemma-locally-finite-presentation-characterize) and Tag 00R2 (algebra-lemma-finite-presentation-independent)

proof.text: The module-surjectivity theorem supplies the neighbourhood-surjectivity principle assumed in both algebra lemmas, for these fields $k,K$ and arbitrary modules. The defining finite polynomial presentation is a surjective polynomial algebra map, hence witnesses finite type by the finite-type definition. Apply finite-type neighbourhood descent to $A,B,u,\mathfrak q_K$ to obtain $c\notin\mathfrak q$ with $B_c$ of finite type over $A$.

source.place: Tag 0C4Y (varieties-lemma-change-fields-flat), assertion (1); agent-written pointwise descent argument using Tag 01TQ (morphisms-lemma-locally-finite-presentation-characterize) and Tag 00R2 (algebra-lemma-finite-presentation-independent)

proof.text: The pullback of $D(c)$ is $D(c\otimes1)$: the projection ring map sends $c$ to $c\otimes1$, so its inverse image is the nonvanishing locus of this element. Replace $U$ by this principal chart $\operatorname{Spec}B_c$. It still contains $x_K$ upstairs because $c\otimes1\notin\mathfrak q_K$, and the marked prime contracts to the localized prime of $x$. With $u$ replaced by its image, its principal open is the old $D(u)\cap D(c\otimes1)$, contained in $W$. The affine-open criterion gives finite presentation of $((B_c)_K)_u$ over $A_K$. Apply finite-presentation neighbourhood descent to the finite type algebra $B_c$, with the principle from Step 2, to obtain $s$ outside its marked prime with $(B_c)_s$ finitely presented over $A$.

source.place: Tag 0C4Y (varieties-lemma-change-fields-flat), assertion (1); agent-written pointwise descent argument using Tag 01TQ (morphisms-lemma-locally-finite-presentation-characterize) and Tag 00R2 (algebra-lemma-finite-presentation-independent)

proof.text: The affine open $\operatorname{Spec}((B_c)_s)$ of $U$ contains $x$ and maps into $V$. Its finite presentation over $A$ witnesses finite presentation at every one of its points by the definition, so it is the required open neighbourhood of $x$.

lean.statement: theorem locallyOfFinitePresentation_near_of_fieldExtension (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] (X Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X.left) : let i := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) ∀ (xK : ↥(pullback X.hom i)), pullback.fst X.hom i xK = x → (∃ W : (pullback X.hom i).Opens, xK ∈ W ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation (W.ι ≫ ((Over.pullback i).map f).left)) → ∃ U : X.left.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation (U.ι ≫ f.left)

reviewed_lean.note: k,K fields with Algebra k K; X,Y,f k-schemes/morphism as Over (Spec k) objects and hom; X_K = pullback X.hom i with i = Spec.map algebraMap; f_K = ((Over.pullback i).map f).left (recorded h_T of def-pc-base-change); xK above x via pullback.fst; hypothesis exists open W ∋ xK with W.ι ≫ f_K LocallyOfFinitePresentation; conclusion exists open U ∋ x with U.ι ≫ f.left LocallyOfFinitePresentation; #check confirms CategoryTheory.Over.pullback and AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFinitePresentation
